Prisma Model: User
chunks.content:
model User {
id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  email      String   @unique
  name       String
  role       Role     @default(TESTER)
  department String?
  avatarUrl  String?
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("users")
}

chunks.title: Prisma Model: Project
chunks.content:
model Project {
id             String     @id @default(uuid())
  name           String
  key            String     @unique
  description    String?
  jiraProjectKey String?
  createdAt      DateTime   @default(now())

  suites         Suite[]
  testCases      TestCase[]
  testRuns       TestRun[]

  @@map("projects")
}

chunks.title: Prisma Model: Suite
chunks.content:
model Suite {
id         String     @id @default(uuid())
  name       String
  projectId  String
  project    Project    @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  parentId   String?
  parent     Suite?     @relation("SuiteToSuite", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  children   Suite[]    @relation("SuiteToSuite")

  cases      TestCase[]
  orderIndex Int        @default(0)

  @@map("suites")
}

chunks.title: Prisma Model: TestCase
chunks.content:
model TestCase {
id           String       @id @default(uuid())
  code         String       @unique
  title        String
  description  String?
  executionType String      @default("MANUAL")
  type         TestType     @default(WEB)
  priority     Priority     @default(NORMAL)
  precondition String?

  projectId    String?
  project      Project?     @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  suiteId      String?
  suite        Suite?       @relation(fields: [suiteId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  steps        TestStep[]
  results      TestResult[]

  // Jira Ready
  jiraStoryKey String?
  jiraIssueUrl String?

  screenshotUrl String?

  createdAt    DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime     @updatedAt

  @@map("test_cases")
}

chunks.title: Prisma Model: TestStep
chunks.content:
model TestStep {
id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  stepNumber     Int
  action         String
  expectedResult String
  attachments    Json?    @default("[]")

  testCaseId     String
  testCase       TestCase @relation(fields: [testCaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("test_steps")
}

chunks.title: Prisma Model: TestRun
chunks.content:
model TestRun {
id          String     @id @default(uuid())
  title       String
  version     String
  environment String
  status      RunStatus  @default(IN_PROGRESS)

  executedBy  String
  testerEmail String

  projectId   String
  project     Project    @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  results     TestResult[]

  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())

  @@map("test_runs")
}

chunks.title: Prisma Model: TestResult
chunks.content:
model TestResult {
id           String       @id @default(uuid())

  testRunId    String
  testRun      TestRun      @relation(fields: [testRunId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  testCaseId   String
  testCase     TestCase     @relation(fields: [testCaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  status       ResultStatus

  executionMs  Int?
  errorMessage String?

  executedBy   String?
  testerEmail  String?

  // Jira Ready
  jiraBugKey   String?
  jiraBugUrl   String?

  screenshotUrl String?

  executedAt   DateTime     @default(now())

  @@map("test_results")
}

chunks.content:
export const ProjectsService = {
  getAll: () => api.get<Project[]>('/projects').then((res) => res.data),
  getOne: (id: string) => api.get<Project>(`/projects/${id}`).then((res) => res.data),
  create: (data: { name: string; key: string; description?: string; jiraProjectKey?: string }) =>
    api.post<Project>('/projects', data).then((res) => res.data),
  update: (id: string, data: { name?: string; key?: string; description?: string; jiraProjectKey?: string }) =>
    api.patch<Project>(`/projects/${id}`, data).then((res) => res.data),
  getTree: (projectId: string) =>
    api.get<TreeResponse>(`/projects/${projectId}/tree`).then((res) => res.data),
  delete: (id: string) => api.delete(`/projects/${id}`).then((res) => res.data),
};

chunks.content:
export const TestRunsService = {
  createRun: (projectId: string, data: CreateRunDto) =>
    api.post<TestRun>(`/projects/${projectId}/runs`, data).then((res) => res.data),
  saveResults: (projectId: string, runId: string, data: SaveResultsDto) =>
    api.post<TestRun>(`/projects/${projectId}/runs/${runId}/results`, data).then((res) => res.data),
  completeRun: (runId: string, status: RunStatus = 'COMPLETED') =>
    api.patch<TestRun>(`/runs/${runId}/complete`, { status }).then((res) => res.data),
  quickRun: (projectId: string, data: { testCaseId: string; status: ResultStatus; version?: string; environment?: string; errorMessage?: string; jiraBugKey?: string; jiraBugUrl?: string; screenshotUrl?: string; executedBy?: string }) =>
    api.post<TestResult>(`/projects/${projectId}/quick-run`, data).then((res) => res.data),
  getRuns: (projectId: string) =>
    api.get<TestRun[]>(`/projects/${projectId}/runs`).then((res) => res.data),
  getRunDetails: (runId: string) =>
    api.get<TestRun>(`/runs/${runId}`).then((res) => res.data),
};
